definition_en: words that praise someone for a success or a happy event
core_image: 亲友围上来，举杯对刚拿到证书的人说恭喜
scene: 毕业典礼散场后，亲友围住拿着证书的年轻人道贺。His congratulation was just one word, but it meant a lot.
sceneCN: 这里 congratulation 指「祝贺的话」（第 1 个义项：对成功或喜事的称贺）；句意是他这一句祝贺虽短，分量却很重。

senses.title: Words of praise
senses.definition: praise spoken to someone who has done well
senses.definitionCN: 对做得好的人说出的称赞话
senses.example: Please accept my congratulation on your success.
senses.exampleCN: 请接受我对你成功的祝贺。
senses.why: A good deed deserves a voice that names it out loud.
senses.whyCN: 一件好事值得有人大声说出来。

senses.title: The plural greeting
senses.definition: the plural form used as a warm greeting on happy events
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式，用于喜事场合的热情祝贺
senses.example: Congratulations! You passed the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 恭喜！你考试通过了。
senses.why: A happy event is often too big for one word, so English doubles it.
senses.whyCN: 喜事往往一句话装不下，所以英语把它说成复数。

intro.en: Congratulation comes from Latin congratulari, to wish joy together, built from com-, together, and gratulari, to show joy.
intro.cn: congratulation 来自拉丁语 congratulari，意为一起道喜，由 com-（一起）与 gratulari（表达喜悦）构成。

items.en: Gratulari meant to show joy or give thanks out loud.
items.cn: gratulari 意为把喜悦或感谢说出口。

items.en: Congratulari added com- to make the joy a shared act.
items.cn: congratulari 加上 com-，让这份喜悦成为共同的行动。

items.en: The noun congratulatio named the act of shared rejoicing.
items.cn: 名词 congratulatio 指共同欢庆的行为。

items.en: French carried the word into polite speech at court.
items.cn: 法语把这个词带进宫廷里的礼貌用语。

items.en: English congratulation first meant a public expression of joy.
items.cn: 英语 congratulation 最初指公开表达喜悦。

items.en: It now appears mostly in the plural as a warm greeting.
items.cn: 如今它多以复数形式出现，用作热情的问候。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words built on the same Latin thanks base, and the meaning group names other kinds of spoken praise.
note.cn: 形近组收的是建立在同一个拉丁语感谢词基上的词，近义组列出其他表示口头称赞的说法。

expressing good wishes for someone
the ceremony of receiving a degree
words that say someone or something is good
a polite remark that admires someone

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a room full of one good word, then move to the doubled plural and to the right moment.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一间满是同一句好话的屋子开始，再走到复数的叠用与恰当的时机。

normal.en: Con- is together and grat- is thanks, so congratulation is thanks spoken together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，grat- 是感谢，congratulation 就是大家一起说出的感谢。

normal.en: A wedding hall full of one good word: that is congratulation.
normal.cn: 整个婚礼大厅说着同一句好话，那就是祝贺。

normal.en: One word of praise is small, so English often doubles it into congratulations.
normal.cn: 一句称赞太轻，所以英语常把它说成复数的 congratulations。

normal.en: A short congratulation at the right moment beats a long letter a week later.
normal.cn: 关键时刻一句简短祝贺，胜过一周后的一封长信。

normal.en: Say it while the good news is still warm.
normal.cn: 趁好消息还热着的时候把它说出口。

abstract.cn: 想象一只杯子朝一张笑脸举起来。

abstract.en: Picture one word written on a card and handed across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一个词写在卡片上，隔着桌子递过去。

abstract.en: Picture a room where every hand claps at the same moment.
abstract.cn: 想象一间屋子里所有的手同时拍响。

examples.en: She sent a short congratulation to the whole team.
examples.cn: 她给整个团队发了一句简短的祝贺。

examples.en: Congratulations on your new job!
examples.cn: 祝贺你找到新工作！

examples.en: His congratulation sounded formal but honest.
examples.cn: 他的祝贺听起来正式，却很真诚。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 congratulation 记成 con（一起）加 grat（感谢）：一群人一起把感谢说出口，就是祝贺。

root: 源自拉丁语 congratulari（com 一起 + gratulari 表达喜悦），本义是一起道喜，后指祝贺的话与贺词。

sensesIntro.en: From one spoken word of praise to the doubled plural that a whole room says at a wedding.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一句说出口的称赞，到婚礼上整间屋子齐声说出的复数祝贺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a circle of people lifting cups and saying one good word.
core.cn: 核心意象：一圈人举起杯子，说着同一句好话。

branches.en: A single congratulation is a spoken gift for a success.
branches.cn: 一句祝贺，是送给成功者的口头礼物。

branches.en: The plural form turns one word into a small round of applause.
branches.cn: 复数形式把一个词变成一小阵掌声。

branches.en: Both senses need a listener who has just done something worth naming.
branches.cn: 两种义项都需要一个刚做成某事的听者。

branches.en: At weddings and graduations the plural is the normal greeting.
branches.cn: 在婚礼与毕业典礼上，复数形式才是常规问候。

branches.en: The word marks a moment, and the moment makes the word warm.
branches.cn: 这个词标记一个时刻，而这个时刻让这个词变暖。

intro.en: Congratulation is built on Latin com-, together, plus gratulari, to show joy.
intro.cn: congratulation 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 gratulari（表达喜悦）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin thanks base grat- also appears in gratitude, grateful and gratify.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的感谢词基 grat- 也出现在 gratitude、grateful 与 gratify 中。

items.meaning: the act of wishing joy to someone
items.example: Their congratulation came before the cake.
items.exampleCN: 他们的祝贺在蛋糕端上来之前就到了。

items.meaning: to speak praise to someone for a success

她说话时带着真诚的感激。

items.example: I am grateful for your help.

items.exampleCN: 他用忘恩负义回报善意。

definition_en: a large formal meeting of representatives, or the law-making body of some countries
core_image: 圆形大厅里，几百名代表同时举手
scene: 大会主席敲了一下木槌，请各地代表就座。The congress opened with a long roll call.
sceneCN: 这里 congress 指「代表大会」（第 1 个义项：代表聚集的正式会议）；句意是这场大会以漫长的点名开场。

senses.title: A meeting of delegates
senses.definition: a large formal meeting where delegates discuss shared business
senses.definitionCN: 代表们讨论共同事务的大型正式会议
senses.example: The medical congress drew experts from twenty countries.
senses.exampleCN: 这次医学大会吸引了二十个国家的专家。
senses.why: People who speak for others sit in one room and decide together.
senses.whyCN: 替别人说话的人坐在同一间屋子里，一起决定事情。

senses.title: The law-making body
senses.definition: the national law-making body of some countries, especially the United States
senses.definitionCN: 某些国家的最高立法机构，尤指美国国会
senses.example: Congress passed the bill after a long debate.
senses.exampleCN: 国会经过长时间辩论通过了这项法案。
senses.why: A meeting that never ends becomes an institution with rules and a building.
senses.whyCN: 一场不会结束的会议，会变成有规章有楼宇的机构。

senses.title: A coming together
senses.definition: the act of coming together, an older and rarer sense
senses.definitionCN: 聚集到一起的行为，是较古老且少用的义项
senses.example: Old maps marked the congress of two rivers.
senses.exampleCN: 古老的地图上标出了两条河流的交汇处。
senses.why: Before it named a hall, the word simply named bodies moving to one point.
senses.whyCN: 在指一座大厅之前，这个词只表示许多身体走向同一点。

intro.en: Congress comes from Latin congressus, a coming together, from com-, together, and gradi, to step or walk.
intro.cn: congress 来自拉丁语 congressus，意为走到一起，由 com-（一起）与 gradi（迈步）构成。

items.en: Gradi meant to step or walk forward.
items.cn: gradi 意为迈步或向前行走。

items.en: Congressus named the act of walking together to one place.
items.cn: congressus 指一起走到同一个地方的行为。

items.en: Old French congres used the word for an assembly of people.
items.cn: 古法语 congres 用这个词指人群的集会。

items.en: English congress first meant a formal meeting of representatives.
items.cn: 英语 congress 最初指代表的正式会议。

items.en: American usage gave it the sense of a national law-making body.
items.cn: 美国用法赋予它国家立法机构的含义。

items.en: It now covers both a single conference and a permanent parliament.
items.cn: 如今它既指一次会议，也指常设的议会。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin step base or the ending of congress, and the meaning group names other law-making bodies.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语迈步词基或 congress 的词尾，近义组列出其他立法机构。

entries.definition: relating to a congress or its members

a large meeting for discussion
the law-making body of a country such as Britain
the upper house of a law-making body

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from delegates walking into one hall, then move to debate and to a permanent chamber.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从代表们走进同一座大厅开始，再到辩论，最后到常设的议事厅。

normal.en: Con- is together and gress is step, so congress is people stepping into one room.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，gress 是迈步，congress 就是众人迈步走进同一间屋子。

normal.en: A congress begins as a meeting and can harden into a parliament.
normal.cn: 代表大会起初只是一场会议，也可能固化成议会。

normal.en: Think of a hall where every seat carries a state or a hospital name.
normal.cn: 想象一座大厅，每个座位都写着州名或医院的名字。

normal.en: A conference lasts days, but a congress keeps a building and a budget.
normal.cn: 研讨会只持续几天，而国会拥有固定的楼宇与预算。

normal.en: When delegates stop walking, the debate starts.
normal.cn: 代表们停下脚步的时候，辩论就开始了。

abstract.en: Picture hundreds of name cards on one long table.
abstract.cn: 想象一张长桌上摆着几百个姓名牌。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden hammer falling on a round hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一把木槌落在圆形大厅里。

abstract.en: Picture many roads meeting at one gate.
abstract.cn: 想象许多条路在同一座门前汇合。

examples.en: The congress will meet in the capital next spring.
examples.cn: 大会明年春天将在首都召开。

examples.en: Congress voted against the new tax.

examples.en: She spoke at an international congress on heart disease.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 congress 记成 con（一起）加 gress（走）：一群人一起走到同一间屋子里开会，就是代表大会，进而指国会。

root: 源自拉丁语 congressus（com 一起 + gradi 迈步），本义是走到一起，后指代表集会与立法机构。

sensesIntro.en: From bodies walking into one hall, to a formal meeting, and finally to a permanent law-making body.
sensesIntro.cn: 从众人走进同一座大厅，到一场正式会议，最后到常设的立法机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many delegates walking in through one wide door.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多代表从同一扇大门走进来。

branches.en: A congress is first of all a large meeting for shared business.
branches.cn: 代表大会首先是为共同事务召开的大型会议。

branches.en: When the meeting becomes permanent, it turns into a law-making body.
branches.cn: 当会议变成常设机构，它就成了立法机关。

branches.en: The old sense simply names things coming to one point.
branches.cn: 古老义项只表示事物汇聚到同一点。

branches.en: Both senses keep the same picture of a room where voices are counted.
branches.cn: 两个义项都保留同一幅画面：一间把声音数清楚的屋子。

branches.en: The national body is the meeting that never goes home.
branches.cn: 国家立法机构就是那场永不散会的会议。

intro.en: Congress is built on Latin com-, together, plus gradi, to step.
intro.cn: congress 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 gradi（迈步）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin step base gress- also appears in progress, regress and aggressive.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的迈步词基 gress- 也出现在 progress、regress 与 aggressive 中。

definition_en: a word that joins other words or clauses, or the act of joining two things
core_image: 两段铁轨在同一处接头，被一块夹板牢牢锁住
scene: 老师让学生把两个短句合成一句。Write two clauses, then join them with a conjunction.
sceneCN: 这里 conjunction 指「连词」（第 1 个义项：连接词或分句的虚词）；句意是先写两个分句，再用一个连词把它们连起来。

senses.title: The joining word
senses.definition: a word such as and or but that joins words or clauses
senses.definitionCN: 像 and 或 but 这样连接词或分句的虚词
senses.example: Put a conjunction between the two clauses.
senses.exampleCN: 在两个分句之间放一个连词。
senses.why: Two thoughts need a small bridge, and this word is that bridge.
senses.whyCN: 两个念头之间需要一座小桥，而这个词就是那座桥。

senses.title: A joining together
senses.definition: the state of two or more things being joined or working together
senses.definitionCN: 两件或多件事物结合、共同作用的状态
senses.example: The show is a conjunction of art and science.
senses.exampleCN: 这场展览是艺术与科学的结合。
senses.why: Things that meet at one point share a moment and a meaning.
senses.whyCN: 在同一点相遇的事物，共享一个时刻与一层意义。

senses.title: A rare alignment
senses.definition: an occasion when several events or planets meet at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 若干事件或天体同时相遇的时机
senses.example: Astrologers watched the conjunction of two planets.
senses.exampleCN: 占星者观察着两颗行星的会合。
senses.why: When separate paths cross at one point, people remember the crossing.
senses.whyCN: 当几条分开的路径交于一点，人们会记住这次交会。

intro.en: Conjunction comes from Latin coniunctio, a joining, from com-, together, and iungere, to join or yoke.
intro.cn: conjunction 来自拉丁语 coniunctio，意为连接，由 com-（一起）与 iungere（连接、套上轭）构成。

items.en: Iungere meant to join or yoke animals to one bar.
items.cn: iungere 意为把牲口套在同一根横木上。

items.en: Coniunctio named a joining of things or of words.
items.cn: coniunctio 指事物的连接，也指词语的连接。

items.en: Old French conjonction kept the grammar sense alive.
items.cn: 古法语 conjonction 把这个语法含义保留下来。

items.en: English conjunction entered as the name of a joining word.
items.cn: 英语 conjunction 最初就是连接词的名字。

items.en: It now also means any coming together of events.
items.cn: 如今它也指事件的任何一次同时发生。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin join base junct-, and the meaning group names other devices that hold parts together.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语连接词基 junct-，近义组列出其他把部分连在一起的东西。

an official order to do or stop something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a hinge between two clauses, then move to two events meeting and to a railway joint.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两个分句之间的铰链开始，再到两件事的相遇与铁轨的接头。

normal.en: Con- is together and junct- is join, so a conjunction joins two parts.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，junct- 是连接，所以连词就是把两部分接起来。

normal.en: And, but, because: three small bridges in one sentence.
normal.cn: and、but、because：一句话里的三座小桥。

normal.en: A conjunction is a hinge on which two doors of meaning swing.
normal.cn: 连词是一副铰链，两扇意义的门靠它开合。

normal.en: When two events happen at once, people call that a conjunction too.
normal.cn: 当两件事同时发生，人们也把这称作一次会合。

normal.en: Remove the word and the sentence falls into two pieces, so it was a conjunction.
normal.cn: 把这个词拿走，句子就散成两半，说明它就是连词。

abstract.en: Picture two rails locked by one steel plate.
abstract.cn: 想象两段钢轨被一块钢板锁在一起。

abstract.en: Picture a hinge that lets two doors move as one.
abstract.cn: 想象一副让两扇门合为一体的铰链。

abstract.en: Picture two paths meeting under a single lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象两条小路在一盏灯下汇合。

examples.en: Use a conjunction to link the two ideas.
examples.cn: 用一个连词把这两个想法连起来。

examples.en: The festival is held in conjunction with the city library.
examples.cn: 这个节庆活动是与市图书馆联合举办的。

examples.en: A strange conjunction of weather and luck saved the harvest.
examples.cn: 天气与运气的奇妙巧合保住了这一季的收成。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conjunction 记成 con（一起）加 junct（连接）：把两句话一起接起来的小词，就是连词。

root: 源自拉丁语 coniunctio（com 一起 + iungere 连接），本义是连接，后专指连接词，也指事件的会合。

sensesIntro.en: From a small grammar word, to any joining of two things, and finally to events meeting at one moment.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个语法小词，到任何两物的结合，最后到事件在同一刻相遇。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hinge that holds two separate parts in one line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一副铰链把两个分开的部分连成一条线。

branches.en: The grammar sense is a single word doing the work of a hinge.
branches.cn: 语法义项就是一个词在承担铰链的工作。

branches.en: Two things joined can also work as one unit.
branches.cn: 被连接的两件事也能作为一个整体运作。

branches.en: Planets or events that meet in time form a rare conjunction.
branches.cn: 在时间上相遇的天体或事件构成罕见的会合。

branches.en: Both senses come from one image of parts held at a joint.
branches.cn: 两个义项都来自同一幅画面：部分被固定在一个接头上。

branches.en: A conjunction in the sky is only a joining seen from far away.
branches.cn: 天上的会合，不过是远看时的一次连接。

intro.en: Conjunction is built on Latin com-, together, plus iungere, to join.
intro.cn: conjunction 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 iungere（连接）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin join base junct- also appears in junction, injunction and disjointed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的连接词基 junct- 也出现在 junction、injunction 与 disjointed 中。

items.exampleCN: 连词可以连接两个分句。

items.example: The conjunctive tissue holds the parts.

这两个问题是连在一起的。

items.meaning: not connected in a clear order

definition_en: to join two things together, or to see how they are related
core_image: 两根电线被拧在一起，灯泡立刻亮起
scene: 电工蹲在配电箱前，把两根电线接妥。Connect the red wire to the blue one.
sceneCN: 这里 connect 指「连接」（第 1 个义项：把两物接在一起）；句意是把红线接到蓝线上。

senses.title: Join two things
senses.definition: to join two objects so that they touch or work together
senses.definitionCN: 把两个物体接在一起，使之接触或共同运作
senses.example: Connect the printer to the computer.
senses.exampleCN: 把打印机接到电脑上。
senses.why: Two loose ends become one working line at the moment they touch.
senses.whyCN: 两个松开的端点一碰，就变成一条能工作的线。

senses.title: See a link
senses.definition: to realize that two facts or people are related
senses.definitionCN: 意识到两件事或两个人之间存在关联
senses.example: She connected the smell with her grandmother's kitchen.

intro.en: Connect comes from Latin connectere, to bind together, from com-, together, and nectere, to tie.
intro.cn: connect 来自拉丁语 connectere，意为绑在一起，由 com-（一起）与 nectere（系、绑）构成。

items.en: Nectere meant to tie or bind one thing to another.
items.cn: nectere 意为把一物系到另一物上。

items.en: Connectere added com- to make the binding mutual.

items.en: Connexus was the participle, already tied into one.

items.en: French connecter carried the tying sense into daily use.
items.cn: 法语 connecter 把这个系绑的含义带入日常使用。

items.en: English connect first meant to fasten two things physically.
items.cn: 英语 connect 最初指把两件东西在物理上固定在一起。

items.en: It now covers wires, ideas, people and networks.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖电线、想法、人与网络。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the shape of connect, and the meaning group names other ways to hold two things together.

senses.title: Being joined

senses.title: A relationship

senses.why: A link that cannot be seen still pulls two facts toward each other.

senses.title: A travel link

senses.why: One vehicle hands you to another, and the journey stays unbroken.

intro.en: Connection comes from Latin connexio, a binding together, from connectere, to tie, and was spelled with an x for centuries.
intro.cn: connection 来自拉丁语 connexio，意为绑在一起，源自动词 connectere（系绑），有几个世纪都写作 x 的拼法。

items.en: Nectere meant to tie, and connectere meant to tie together.
items.cn: nectere 意为系绑，connectere 意为绑在一起。

items.en: Connexio named the joint or the act of binding.
items.cn: connexio 指接合处或绑缚的行为。

items.en: Old French connexion kept the x of the Latin participle.
items.cn: 古法语 connexion 保留了拉丁语分词里的 x。

items.en: English took the word as connexion and used it for any join.
items.cn: 英语以 connexion 的形式借入，用来指任何连接。

items.en: Writers began to spell it connection to match the Latin verb.
items.cn: 写作者开始把它拼作 connection，以贴合拉丁动词。

items.en: Connection is now standard, and it also means a train or flight link.
items.cn: 如今 connection 是标准拼法，也指火车或航班的接续。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that echo the sound or shape of connection, and the meaning group names other kinds of link.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 connection 音形相近的词，近义组列出其他表示联系的说法。

sensesIntro.en: From a physical joint, to a relationship between facts or people, and finally to a train or flight that carries you onward.

intro.en: Conquer comes from Latin conquirere, to seek out and obtain, from com-, fully, and quaerere, to seek.
intro.cn: conquer 来自拉丁语 conquirere，意为四处寻求并取得，由 com-（彻底）与 quaerere（寻求）构成。

items.en: Quaerere meant to seek, ask or search for.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻求、询问、搜寻。

items.en: Conquirere meant to seek out thoroughly and collect.
items.cn: conquirere 意为彻底搜寻并收集。

items.en: In late Latin the word gained the military sense of winning ground.
items.cn: 在晚期拉丁语中，这个词获得了攻占土地的军事含义。

items.en: Old French conquere told of knights winning lands.
items.cn: 古法语 conquere 讲述骑士赢得土地的故事。

items.en: English conquer first meant to win by fighting.
items.cn: 英语 conquer 最初指靠打仗赢取。

items.en: It now also means to master a fear or a difficult skill.
items.cn: 如今它也指战胜恐惧或掌握一项难学的技能。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words confusingly close in sound or form, and the meaning group names other ways to win.
note.cn: 形近组收的是读音或外形容易混淆的词，近义组列出其他表示赢取的说法。

entries.definition: to agree with someone
a person who takes land by force
the act of taking control by force
to win against an opponent
to succeed against a difficulty
to defeat completely in battle

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a flag on a wall, then move to a rival who yields and to a fear that is finally faced.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从城墙上的旗帜开始，再到让步的对手，最后到终于被面对的恐惧。

normal.en: Con- is fully and quer- is seek, so conquer is to seek until the thing is yours.
normal.cn: con- 是彻底，quer- 是寻求，conquer 就是一直寻求直到把东西拿到手。

normal.en: Divide and conquer: split the problem, then take each part.
normal.cn: 分而治之：先拆开问题，再逐个拿下。

normal.en: A flag on a wall is a conquest finished.
normal.cn: 城墙上的旗子，是一桩征服已经完成的标志。

normal.en: Fear is the city inside you, and courage is the army.
normal.cn: 恐惧是你心里的城，勇气就是那支军队。

normal.en: You conquer a mountain one step at a time, not in one leap.
normal.cn: 征服一座山要一步一步走，而不是一跃而上。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pulling a flag from a bag.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从袋子里抽出一面旗。

abstract.en: Picture a locked gate opening from the inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇锁着的门从里面被打开。

abstract.en: Picture a shadow shrinking as a person walks toward it.
abstract.cn: 想象人朝影子走去时，影子越缩越小。

examples.en: The army conquered the city within a week.
examples.cn: 军队在一周之内攻下了这座城市。

examples.en: She conquered her fear of the stage.
examples.cn: 她克服了对舞台的恐惧。

examples.en: He finally conquered the steep climb.
examples.cn: 他终于征服了这段陡坡。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conquer 记成 con（彻底）加 quer（寻求）：一路追着目标不放，直到把城池或恐惧都拿下来。

root: 源自拉丁语 conquirere（com 彻底 + quaerere 寻求），本义是彻底搜寻取得，后转为以武力征服与克服困难。

sensesIntro.en: From an army taking a city, to a rival beaten, and finally to a private fear finally mastered.
sensesIntro.cn: 从军队攻下城池，到对手被击败，最后到私人恐惧终于被掌控。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a banner raised where another banner used to stand.
core.cn: 核心意象：在原先插着别家旗帜的地方，升起自己的旗。

branches.en: The first sense is land taken and held by force.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是靠武力夺取并守住的土地。

branches.en: The second sense is an opponent who can no longer resist.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是再也无力抵抗的对手。

branches.en: The third sense moves the battlefield inside the person.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把战场移到了人的内心。

branches.en: Taking a place and beating its defenders are one act seen twice.
branches.cn: 占领一地与击败守军，是同一行为的两个侧面。

branches.en: The strength that beats an army can also beat a habit.
branches.cn: 能击败军队的力量，也能击败一个旧习惯。

intro.en: Conquer is built on Latin com-, fully, plus quaerere, to seek.
intro.cn: conquer 由拉丁语 com-（彻底）与 quaerere（寻求）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin seek base quer- also appears in query and quest, and in inquire and require.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的寻求词基 quer- 也出现在 query、quest、inquire 与 require 中。

senses.title: Taking by force

senses.whyCN: 土地换了手，地图就得重新画。

senses.title: Something won
senses.definition: a place, people or thing won in this way

senses.title: A personal victory

senses.example: He treated the friendship as a conquest.
senses.exampleCN: 他把这段友情当成一次征服。

senses.whyCN: 这个古老的军事词，被借来形容心上的胜利。

intro.en: Conquest comes from Old French conqueste, from Latin conquirere, to seek out and obtain.
intro.cn: conquest 来自古法语 conqueste，源头是拉丁语 conquirere，意为四处寻求并取得。

items.en: Quaerere meant to seek, and conquirere meant to obtain by seeking.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻求，conquirere 意为通过寻求而取得。

items.en: The noun conquestus named what had been won.
items.cn: 名词 conquestus 指已经赢到手的东西。

items.en: Old French conqueste was used for lands won in war.
items.cn: 古法语 conqueste 用于指战争中赢得的土地。

items.en: English conquest first meant the act of winning by arms.
items.cn: 英语 conquest 最初指以武力赢取的行为。

items.en: It also came to mean the thing won, not only the act.
items.cn: 它也开始指被赢得的对象，而不只是行为。

items.en: The word now extends to victories in love and in personal struggle.
items.cn: 如今这个词也扩展到爱情与个人奋斗中的胜利。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin seek base quest-, and the meaning group names other kinds of win.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语寻求词基 quest-，近义组列出其他表示胜利的词。

entries.definition: an act of politely asking for something
a long search for something important
the person who wins a conquest
success in a battle or contest
a great and celebrated victory

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a map repainted, then move to the spoils that are named and to a heart won like a city.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一张被改画的地图开始，再到被点名的战果，最后到像攻城一样被赢得的心。

normal.en: Conquest is conquer turned into a noun, so it is the whole event in one word.
normal.cn: conquest 是 conquer 变成名词，用一词装下整件事。

normal.en: Think of a map where one colour spreads over another.
normal.cn: 想想地图上一种颜色盖住另一种颜色。

normal.en: The act is the fighting, and the conquest is the land you can point to.
normal.cn: 行为是打仗，而 conquest 是你能用手指出的那片土地。

normal.en: A conquest needs a flag, a name and a date.
normal.cn: 一次占领需要一面旗、一个名字和一个日期。

normal.en: Love also has its conquests, though no one draws a map.
normal.cn: 爱情也有它的战果，只是没人画地图。

abstract.en: Picture a pen changing one country's colour.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔改变了一个国家的颜色。

abstract.en: Picture a key handed over at a city gate.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙在城门处被交出来。

abstract.en: Picture a name carved on a stone after the battle.
abstract.cn: 想象战后石头上刻下的一个名字。

examples.en: The conquest of the city took three months.
examples.cn: 攻占这座城市用了三个月。

examples.en: The old empire lived on its past conquests.
examples.cn: 这个古老帝国靠过去的战果维持。

examples.en: He saw the new friendship as a quiet conquest.
examples.cn: 他把这段新的友情看作一次安静的赢得。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conquest 记成 conquer（征服）加 st 名词尾：攻城这件事和攻下来的城池，都叫 conquest。

root: 源自拉丁语 conquirere（com 彻底 + quaerere 寻求）的名词形式，经古法语 conqueste 进入英语，指征服行为与被征服的成果。

sensesIntro.en: From the act of taking land, to the land itself, and finally to a victory won over a heart.
sensesIntro.cn: 从夺取土地的行为，到土地本身，最后到在人心上取得的胜利。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a map repainted in one colour after an army passes.
core.cn: 核心意象：军队走过之后，地图被重新涂成一种颜色。

branches.en: The core sense is the act of seizing control.
branches.cn: 核心义项是夺取控制权这一行为。

branches.en: The result sense points at the land or people now held.
branches.cn: 结果义项指向如今被占有的土地或人民。

branches.en: The personal sense borrows the military picture for love.
branches.cn: 个人义项把军事画面借给了爱情。

branches.en: The act and its prize are two halves of one story.
branches.cn: 行为与战利品是同一个故事的两半。

branches.en: In both cases something is won and then kept.
branches.cn: 两种情形里，都是先赢得某物，再把它留住。

intro.en: Conquest carries the Latin seek base quest-, from quaerere, to seek.
intro.cn: conquest 带着拉丁语的寻求词基 quest-，源自动词 quaerere（寻求）。

latinIntro.en: The same seek base appears in request, quest and question.
latinIntro.cn: 同一个寻求词基也出现在 request、quest 与 question 中。

items.meaning: the winning of land or people
a sentence that asks for an answer
items.exampleCN: 他问了一个简单的问题。
他们打听了火车的情况。

definition_en: the inner sense of what is right and wrong in your own behaviour
core_image: 深夜独坐，心里有个声音在轻声责备自己
scene: 他把多找的零钱还回去，才觉得心里安稳。His conscience would not let him keep the money.
sceneCN: 这里 conscience 指「良心」（第 1 个义项：内心判断是非的能力）；句意是良心不容他把这笔钱留下。

senses.title: The inner judge
senses.definition: the inner sense of right and wrong in your own actions
senses.definitionCN: 内心对自己行为是非的判断力
senses.example: Her conscience told her to confess.
senses.exampleCN: 她的良心叫她坦白。
senses.why: No witness is needed when the judge lives inside you.
senses.whyCN: 当法官住在你心里，就不需要别的证人。

senses.title: A feeling of guilt
senses.definition: a feeling of guilt about something you have done
senses.definitionCN: 对自己做过的事感到有罪的不安
senses.example: He had a guilty conscience for weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 他内疚了好几个星期。
senses.why: A wrong act keeps sending its bill back to the same desk.
senses.whyCN: 做错的事会把账单一次次送回同一张桌子。

senses.title: Moral principle
senses.definition: a shared moral sense that guides what people support
senses.definitionCN: 引导人们支持什么的一种共同道义感
senses.example: The vote was a matter of conscience, not of party.
senses.exampleCN: 这次投票是良知问题，而不是党派问题。
senses.why: Some choices are made by a whole person, not by a side.
senses.whyCN: 有些选择由整个人做出，而不是由某个阵营做出。

intro.en: Conscience comes from Latin conscientia, knowledge shared with oneself, from com-, with, and scire, to know.
intro.cn: conscience 来自拉丁语 conscientia，意为与自己共知，由 com-（与）与 scire（知道）构成。

items.en: Scire meant to know or to understand.
items.cn: scire 意为知道或明白。

items.en: Conscire meant to know something together with another.
items.cn: conscire 意为与另一个人共同知道某事。

items.en: Conscientia also meant knowing with yourself, hence a private judge.
items.cn: conscientia 也表示与自己共知，由此成为内心的审判者。

items.en: Old French conscience carried the moral sense.
items.cn: 古法语 conscience 承载了道德含义。

items.en: English conscience meant the inward knowledge of good and evil.
items.cn: 英语 conscience 指内心对善恶的认识。

items.en: It now also names the unease you feel after doing wrong.
items.cn: 如今它也指做错事后感到的不安。

note.en: The look-alike group is the conscious family, often mixed up with this word, and the meaning group names related moral ideas.
note.cn: 形近组是与它常被混淆的 conscious 家族，近义组列出相关的道德概念。

entries.definition: awake and aware of what is around you
the state of being awake and aware
careful to do what is right and proper
beliefs about right and wrong behaviour

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a voice in a quiet room, then move to the bill you cannot refuse and to a vote made alone.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从安静房间里的一道声音开始，再到你无法拒收的账单，最后到独自做出的投票。

normal.en: Con- is with and sci- is know, so conscience is knowing with yourself.
normal.cn: con- 是与，sci- 是知道，conscience 就是与自己一同知道。

normal.en: A clear conscience sleeps well; a guilty one keeps the light on.
normal.cn: 问心无愧的人睡得香，心虚的人一直开着灯。

normal.en: The judge wears no robe and sits inside your chest.
normal.cn: 这位法官不穿法袍，就坐在你胸口里面。

normal.en: Doing right when nobody watches is the whole test.
normal.cn: 没人看着时仍做对的事，这就是全部的考验。

normal.en: A matter of conscience is one you cannot hand to someone else.
normal.cn: 良心问题，是你没法转交给别人的问题。

abstract.en: Picture a small lamp still burning in an empty room.
abstract.cn: 想象空房间里一盏还亮着的小灯。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pushing back a coin across a counter.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把一枚硬币推回柜台。

abstract.en: Picture a mark made on a paper while no one looks.
abstract.cn: 想象无人旁观时在纸上画下的一个记号。

examples.en: His conscience would not let him lie.
examples.cn: 他的良心不容他撒谎。

examples.en: She has a clear conscience about the decision.
examples.cn: 她对这个决定问心无愧。

examples.en: The question troubled his conscience for years.
examples.cn: 这个问题让他的良心不安了好多年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conscience 记成 con（与自己一起）加 sci（知道）：心里那个知道你所有事的小声音，就是良心。

root: 源自拉丁语 conscientia（com 与 + scire 知道），本义是与自己共知，后指内心善恶的判断力与内疚感。

sensesIntro.en: From the inward judge, to the guilt it leaves behind, and finally to a moral stand taken in public.
sensesIntro.cn: 从内心的审判者，到它留下的内疚，最后到公开场合下的道义立场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a quiet voice in an empty room that knows what you did.
core.cn: 核心意象：空房间里一道安静的声音，知道你都做过什么。

branches.en: The core sense is the ability to judge your own acts.
branches.cn: 核心义项是评判自身行为的能力。

branches.en: When the judgement goes against you, it becomes guilt.
branches.cn: 当判断对你不利时，它就变成内疚。

branches.en: The same sense can guide a public stand on a hard question.
branches.cn: 同一种感受也能指引人在难题上公开表态。

branches.en: The judge and the pain are one system working inside a person.
branches.cn: 审判者与痛苦，是同一套在人心内运作的系统。

branches.en: Guilt is private, while a matter of conscience can be public.
branches.cn: 内疚是私下的，而良心问题可以是公开的。

intro.en: Conscience is built on Latin com-, with, plus scire, to know.
intro.cn: conscience 由拉丁语 com-（与）与 scire（知道）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin know base sci- also appears in conscious, science and omniscient.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的知道词基 sci- 也出现在 conscious、science 与 omniscient 中。

items.meaning: knowledge of right and wrong within oneself

items.example: She was conscious of the danger.

items.meaning: careful to do what is right

items.meaningCN: 失去知觉的或未察觉的

definition_zh: 有意识的；清醒的；察觉到的；刻意的

pos.zh: 有意识的；清醒的；察觉的；刻意的

senses.title: Awake and aware
senses.definition: awake and able to think and feel
senses.definitionCN: 醒着，能够思考与感受

senses.why: The light is on behind the eyes again.

senses.title: Noticing something

senses.example: She was conscious of every sound in the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她察觉到房间里的每一种声音。

senses.whyCN: 注意力把背景里的声音，变成你必须回应的事实。

senses.title: Done on purpose
senses.definition: deliberate and intended rather than accidental
senses.definitionCN: 有意为之，而非偶然发生
senses.example: He made a conscious effort to slow down.
senses.exampleCN: 他刻意放慢了速度。

senses.whyCN: 你能看见自己做出的选择，才是你真正拥有的选择。

intro.en: Conscious comes from Latin conscius, knowing with others or within oneself, from com-, with, and scire, to know.
intro.cn: conscious 来自拉丁语 conscius，意为与他人或与自己共知，由 com-（与）与 scire（知道）构成。

items.en: Scire meant to know, and conscius meant sharing that knowledge.
items.cn: scire 意为知道，conscius 意为共享这份知识。

items.en: A conscious person was one who knew a thing with another.
items.cn: conscius 的人，是与另一个人共同知道某事的人。

items.en: Later the knowing turned inward, meaning aware of oneself.
items.cn: 后来这种知道转向内部，表示对自身的察觉。

items.en: English conscious first meant sharing knowledge of something.
items.cn: 英语 conscious 最初指对某事知情。

items.en: It settled into the modern sense of awake and aware.
items.cn: 它逐渐固定为清醒而有察觉的现代含义。

note.en: The look-alike group is the conscience family, and the meaning group names other words for being aware or deliberate.
note.cn: 形近组是 conscience 家族，近义组列出其他表示察觉或刻意的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from eyes opening in a hospital bed, then move to a sound you cannot ignore and to a step you choose to take.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从病床上睁开的眼睛开始，再到无法忽略的声音，最后到你选择迈出的一步。

normal.en: Con- is with and sci- is know, so conscious is knowing with your own mind.
normal.cn: con- 是与，sci- 是知道，conscious 就是用自己的心智去知道。

normal.en: Waking up is the first conscious moment of the day.
normal.cn: 醒来，是一天中第一个有意识的时刻。

normal.en: To be conscious of a sound is to let it into your mind.
normal.cn: 察觉到一种声音，就是让它进入你的头脑。

normal.en: A conscious choice leaves a footprint you can point to.
normal.cn: 有意的选择，会留下一个你能指出的脚印。

normal.en: Half awake is not conscious enough to drive.
normal.cn: 半睡半醒，还没清醒到可以开车。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp switching on above a bed.
abstract.cn: 想象床头上方一盏灯被打开。

abstract.en: Picture a finger lifted to say wait a moment.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指举起来，示意稍等。

abstract.en: Picture a foot placed slowly and on purpose.
abstract.cn: 想象一只脚缓慢而刻意地落下。

examples.en: He was conscious during the whole flight.
examples.cn: 整个飞行途中他都是清醒的。

examples.en: I am conscious of my own limits.
examples.cn: 我清楚自己的限度。

examples.en: She made a conscious choice to stay.
examples.cn: 她是有意选择留下来的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conscious 记成 con（与自己一起）加 sci（知道）加 ous（形容词）：心里明白自己与周围在发生什么，就是有意识。

root: 源自拉丁语 conscius（com 与 + scire 知道），本义是共知，后转为对自身与周围有察觉，并引申出刻意的含义。

sensesIntro.en: From eyes opening, to a sound entering the mind, and finally to a step taken on purpose.
sensesIntro.cn: 从眼睛睁开，到声音进入头脑，最后到刻意迈出的一步。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp switched on behind the eyes.
core.cn: 核心意象：眼睛后面有一盏灯被点亮。

branches.en: The first sense is simply being awake and able to think.
branches.cn: 第一个义项只是醒着并能思考。

branches.en: The second sense points outward at something noticed.
branches.cn: 第二个义项目光向外，指向被注意到的事物。

branches.en: The third sense turns awareness into a chosen act.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把觉察变成有意的行动。

branches.en: You must be awake before anything can be noticed.
branches.cn: 必须先醒着，才可能注意到什么。

branches.en: Noticing a habit is the first step to changing it on purpose.
branches.cn: 察觉一个习惯，是刻意改变它的第一步。

intro.en: Conscious is built on Latin com-, with, plus scire, to know, and the adjective ending -ous.
intro.cn: conscious 由拉丁语 com-（与）与 scire（知道）加上形容词词尾 -ous 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin know base sci- also appears in science, conscience and omniscient.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的知道词基 sci- 也出现在 science、conscience 与 omniscient 中。

items.exampleCN: 药物让他的意识变得迟钝。

items.example: He was unconscious on the floor.
items.exampleCN: 他倒在地板上失去了知觉。

items.example: A subconscious habit shaped her choice.
items.exampleCN: 一个潜意识习惯塑造了她的选择。

items.meaning: the inner sense of right and wrong

items.exampleCN: 没有哪位老师无所不知。

definition_en: the state of being awake and able to think, or awareness of a shared issue
core_image: 麻醉退去，天花板的灯光一点点变清晰
scene: 麻醉慢慢退去，病人终于认出病房里的窗帘。He lost consciousness for a few seconds.
sceneCN: 这里 consciousness 指「知觉」（第 2 个义项：清醒并感知外界的状态）；句意是他有几秒钟失去了知觉。

senses.title: Being awake
senses.definition: the state of being awake and able to think and feel
senses.definitionCN: 醒着并能思考、感受的状态
senses.example: He slowly regained consciousness in the ambulance.
senses.exampleCN: 他在救护车里慢慢恢复了知觉。
senses.why: The inner light goes out, and then it comes back.
senses.whyCN: 心里的灯先熄灭，然后又亮起来。

senses.title: Awareness of something
senses.definition: the fact of noticing or caring about an issue
senses.definitionCN: 对某个问题的注意与关心
senses.example: There is growing consciousness of water waste.
senses.exampleCN: 人们对水资源浪费的意识正在增强。
senses.why: A problem becomes real to a person only when it is noticed.
senses.whyCN: 一个问题被人注意到，才对这个人变得真实。

senses.title: A shared mindset
senses.definition: the shared beliefs and feelings of a group
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体共有的信念与感受
senses.example: The movement changed public consciousness.
senses.exampleCN: 这场运动改变了公众意识。
senses.why: Many private minds can settle into one common weather.
senses.whyCN: 许多私人的心思，可以沉淀成一种共同的天气。

intro.en: Consciousness is conscious plus the noun ending -ness, built on Latin conscius, knowing with oneself.
intro.cn: consciousness 是 conscious 加名词词尾 -ness，源头是拉丁语 conscius，意为与自己共知。

items.en: Scire meant to know, and conscius meant sharing knowledge.
items.cn: scire 意为知道，conscius 意为共享知识。

items.en: The noun conscientia named inward knowledge of oneself.
items.cn: 名词 conscientia 指对自身的内部知识。

items.en: English formed consciousness from conscious and -ness.
items.cn: 英语用 conscious 加 -ness 造出 consciousness。

items.en: Psychology made it the name of the waking mind.
items.cn: 心理学把它定为清醒心智的名称。

items.en: It now also means a group's shared awareness of an issue.
items.cn: 如今它也指一个群体对某个问题的共同意识。

note.en: The look-alike group is the conscience family, and the meaning group names other states of noticing.
note.cn: 形近组是 conscience 家族，近义组列出其他表示察觉状态的词。

entries.definition: the inner sense of right and wrong
awake and aware
careful to do what is right
knowledge that something exists
the state of being quick to notice
the part of a person that thinks and feels

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a waking patient, then move to a problem people begin to see and to a mood shared by a crowd.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从醒来的病人开始，再到人们开始看见的问题，最后到人群共有的情绪。

normal.en: Conscious plus -ness is simply the state of being conscious.
normal.cn: conscious 加 -ness，就是处于有意识状态。

normal.en: Losing consciousness is a light going out; regaining it is the switch clicking back.
normal.cn: 失去知觉是灯灭了，恢复知觉是开关又咔哒一声。

normal.en: Social consciousness begins when a private worry becomes a public word.
normal.cn: 社会意识始于私人的担忧变成一个公开的词。

normal.en: A raised consciousness is a raised hand.
normal.cn: 被唤醒的觉悟，就是一只举起来的手。

normal.en: The word sounds like conscience but points at the light, not the judge.
normal.cn: 这个词听起来像 conscience，但它指那盏灯，而不是法官。

abstract.en: Picture a white ceiling slowly coming into focus.
abstract.cn: 想象白色的天花板慢慢变清晰。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd all turning to look at one sign.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人同时转头看同一块牌子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand held up in a dark hall.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗大厅里举起的一只手。

examples.en: The blow did not cost him consciousness.
examples.cn: 那一击没有让他失去知觉。

examples.en: Environmental consciousness has grown in the past decade.
examples.cn: 环保意识在过去十年里增强了。

examples.en: She spoke with a new consciousness of her own rights.
examples.cn: 她带着对自身权利的新觉悟说话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consciousness 记成 conscious（有意识的）加 ness（状态）：灯亮着的那种状态，就是意识。

root: 由拉丁语 conscius（com 与 + scire 知道）经 conscious 加 -ness 构成，指清醒感知的状态，后扩展为群体觉悟。

sensesIntro.en: From the light of a waking mind, to noticing a problem, and finally to a belief shared by many.
sensesIntro.cn: 从清醒心智的光，到注意到某个问题，最后到许多人共有的信念。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a light that can go out and come back on.
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏会熄灭也会重新亮起的灯。

branches.en: The first sense is the bare state of being awake.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是醒着这一基本状态。

branches.en: The second sense adds an object: something is noticed.
branches.cn: 第二个义项加上了对象：某件事被注意到。

branches.en: The third sense spreads that noticing across a whole group.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这种注意扩展到整个群体。

branches.en: Being awake is the ground on which any noticing stands.
branches.cn: 醒着，是任何察觉得以成立的地面。

branches.en: One person's noticing becomes a group's consciousness when others agree.
branches.cn: 一个人的察觉，在别人认同后就成了群体的意识。

intro.en: Consciousness is conscious plus -ness, from Latin com-, with, and scire, to know.
intro.cn: consciousness 是 conscious 加 -ness，源自拉丁语 com-（与）与 scire（知道）。

latinIntro.en: The Latin know base sci- also appears in science, conscience and omniscient.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的知道词基 sci- 也出现在 science、conscience 与 omniscient 中。

items.exampleCN: 他在黎明时恢复了知觉。

items.example: She was conscious of the risk.
He consciously kept his voice low.
The image stayed in her subconscious.
items.exampleCN: 那个画面留在她的潜意识里。

items.meaning: the inner sense of right and wrong

items.exampleCN: 那个声音听起来无所不知。

definition_en: to agree to something, or official permission for something to happen
core_image: 合同末尾，笔尖在签名栏上停了一秒才落下
scene: 医生把手术同意书推到家属面前，等他们点头。Her parents consented to the trip.
sceneCN: 这里 consent 指「同意」（第 1 个义项：表示许可）；句意是她的父母同意了这趟旅行。

senses.title: Say yes
senses.definition: to agree to something or give permission for it
senses.definitionCN: 同意某事或给予许可
senses.example: She consented to the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 她同意接受采访。
senses.why: Two wills meet, and one of them stops resisting.
senses.whyCN: 两种意愿相遇，其中一种不再抵抗。

senses.title: Official permission
senses.definition: official agreement that allows something to happen
senses.definitionCN: 允许某事发生的正式同意
senses.example: The builder needs written consent from the owner.
senses.exampleCN: 施工方需要业主的书面同意。
senses.why: A spoken yes fades, so the law asks it to leave a mark.
senses.whyCN: 口头答应会消散，所以法律要求它留下痕迹。

senses.title: A shared view
senses.definition: general agreement among a group, an older and rarer sense
senses.definitionCN: 一群人的普遍一致，是较古老且少用的义项
senses.example: By common consent the plan was dropped.
senses.exampleCN: 经大家一致同意，这个计划被放弃了。
senses.why: When many feelings move the same way, no vote is needed.
senses.whyCN: 当许多人的感受朝同一方向走，就不需要投票了。

intro.en: Consent comes from Latin consentire, to feel together, from com-, together, and sentire, to feel.
intro.cn: consent 来自拉丁语 consentire，意为一起感受，由 com-（一起）与 sentire（感觉）构成。

items.en: Sentire meant to feel, perceive or think.
items.cn: sentire 意为感觉、察觉或思考。

items.en: Consentire meant to feel the same way as another.
items.cn: consentire 意为与另一个人感受相同。

items.en: The noun consensus named that shared feeling.
items.cn: 名词 consensus 指这种共同的感受。

items.en: Old French consentir carried the sense of agreeing.
items.cn: 古法语 consentir 带有同意的含义。

items.en: English consent first meant to agree or be of one mind.
items.cn: 英语 consent 最初指同意或心意一致。

items.en: It now also names formal permission in law and medicine.
items.cn: 如今它也指法律与医疗中的正式许可。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the sound of consent, and the meaning group names other ways of saying yes.
note.cn: 形近组与 consent 读音相近，近义组列出其他表示答应的说法。

entries.definition: an opinion shared by most people
formal agreement to a plan
to feel angry about something unfair
to have the same opinion
to officially accept something
the right to do something given by someone

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from two people feeling the same way, then move to a signature and to a room that agrees without voting.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两个人感受相同开始，再到一个签名，最后到不用投票就一致的房间。

normal.en: Con- is together and sent- is feel, so consent is to feel along with someone.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sent- 是感觉，consent 就是跟着对方一起感受。

normal.en: A nod is the shortest contract in the world.
normal.cn: 一个点头，是世界上最简短的合同。

normal.en: Consent given in writing is a yes you cannot take back easily.
normal.cn: 写下来的同意，是难以轻易收回的答应。

normal.en: No consent, no entry: the same rule for doors and for bodies.
normal.cn: 没有同意就不许进：门如此，人也是如此。

normal.en: When everyone consents, the meeting ends early.
normal.cn: 大家都同意时，会就提前散了。

abstract.en: Picture a pen hovering above a line.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔在一条横线上方悬着。

abstract.en: Picture two heads nodding at the same second.
abstract.cn: 想象两个头在同一秒点下去。

abstract.en: Picture a door opened from the inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门从里面被打开。

examples.en: He consented to the search of his bag.
examples.cn: 他同意接受检查他的包。

examples.en: No one may enter the site without consent.
examples.cn: 未经许可，任何人不得进入场地。

examples.en: Her consent was given in writing.
examples.cn: 她的同意是以书面形式给出的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consent 记成 con（一起）加 sent（感觉）：两个人感觉到一起去了，自然就点头同意。

root: 源自拉丁语 consentire（com 一起 + sentire 感觉），本义是感受相同，后指同意、赞同与正式许可。

sensesIntro.en: From two feelings moving as one, to a signed permission, and finally to a whole group thinking alike.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两种感受合而为一，到签下的许可，最后到整个群体想法一致。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two heads nodding at the very same moment.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个头在同一瞬间点下去。

branches.en: The verb is the act of agreeing or allowing.
branches.cn: 动词义项就是同意或允许的动作。

branches.en: The noun sense is the permission that remains on record.
branches.cn: 名词义项是留在记录里的那份许可。

branches.en: The older sense is a group feeling the same way.
branches.cn: 较古老的义项是一群人感受相同。

branches.en: Saying yes and the paper that proves it are one process.
branches.cn: 说出同意与证明它的那张纸，是同一个过程。

branches.en: Both rest on people finding that their feelings match.
branches.cn: 两者都建立在人们发现彼此感受相合之上。

intro.en: Consent is built on Latin com-, together, plus sentire, to feel.
intro.cn: consent 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 sentire（感觉）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin feel base sent- also appears in assent, dissent, resent and sensation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的感觉词基 sent- 也出现在 assent、dissent、resent 与 sensation 中。

items.meaning: to feel the same and agree

items.exampleCN: 这是一个双方同意的决定。
两位法官写下了反对意见。

items.meaning: to feel anger again and again
items.exampleCN: 她对那条不公平的规定感到愤恨。

items.example: A cold sensation spread down his arm.
items.exampleCN: 一阵冰凉的感觉顺着手臂蔓延。

definition_en: a result of an action, or importance in a situation
core_image: 推倒第一张骨牌，后面的牌一张张跟着倒
scene: 他没带伞就出门，回来时浑身湿透。Skipping breakfast had clear consequences for his day.
sceneCN: 这里 consequence 指「后果」（第 1 个义项：行为带来的结果）；句意是不吃早饭对他这一天造成了明显的后果。

derivatives.zh: 随之发生的；作为结果的

senses.title: A result
senses.definition: a result that follows from an action or condition
senses.definitionCN: 由行为或情况引发的直接结果
senses.example: The consequence of the delay was a lost contract.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误的后果是丢了一份合同。
senses.why: Every action sets a line in motion, and the line arrives somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 每个行动都让一条线开始运动，而这条线终会抵达某处。

senses.title: Importance
senses.definition: importance or significance, often in the phrase of consequence
senses.definitionCN: 重要性或意义，常见于 of consequence 的说法
senses.example: The decision was of great consequence.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定关系重大。
senses.why: Something that pulls many other things behind it must be heavy.
senses.whyCN: 能拉动许多别的东西的事物，本身一定很重。

senses.title: A logical conclusion
senses.definition: a conclusion drawn from a set of facts
senses.definitionCN: 由一组事实推出的结论
senses.example: From these facts one consequence is unavoidable.
senses.exampleCN: 由这些事实可以得出一个无法回避的结论。
senses.why: Reason walks forward, and this is the place it must stop.
senses.whyCN: 推理一路向前走，而这里就是它必须停下的地方。

intro.en: Consequence comes from Latin consequentia, a following after, from com-, together, and sequi, to follow.
intro.cn: consequence 来自拉丁语 consequentia，意为随后而来，由 com-（一起）与 sequi（跟随）构成。

items.en: Sequi meant to follow behind someone.
items.cn: sequi 意为跟在某人后面。

items.en: Consequi meant to follow after and reach the same point.
items.cn: consequi 意为随后跟到同一点。

items.en: Consequentia named what follows from something else.
items.cn: consequentia 指由别的事物引出的东西。

items.en: Old French consequence used the word for a result.
items.cn: 古法语 consequence 用这个词指结果。

items.en: English consequence first meant what follows in logic.
items.cn: 英语 consequence 最初指逻辑上随之而来的东西。

items.en: It now also means weight or importance.
items.cn: 如今它也指分量或重要性。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin follow base, and the meaning group names other results.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语跟随词基，近义组列出其他表示结果的词。

entries.definition: a set of things in a fixed order
entries.definitionCN: 按固定顺序排列的一系列事物

entries.definition: following as a result
as a result
what happens because of something else
the final effect of a process
a change caused by an action

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from falling dominoes, then move to the weight of a big decision and to a conclusion you cannot avoid.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从倒下的骨牌开始，再到重大决定的分量，最后到无法回避的结论。

normal.en: Con- is together and sequ- is follow, so a consequence is what follows an act.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sequ- 是跟随，consequence 就是跟着行为而来的东西。

normal.en: One push on the first domino, and the whole row falls.
normal.cn: 推一下第一张骨牌，整排都会倒下。

normal.en: If you cannot carry the result, do not start the act.
normal.cn: 若你背不起结果，就别开始这个行为。

normal.en: Of little consequence means the thing weighs almost nothing.
normal.cn: of little consequence 意思是这件事几乎没有分量。

normal.en: A sequence is an order; a consequence is the price of that order.
normal.cn: sequence 是顺序，consequence 是这顺序要付的代价。

abstract.en: Picture a line of tiles tipping one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象一排骨牌一个接一个倒下。

abstract.en: Picture a stone dropped into still water.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗石子落进平静的水面。

abstract.en: Picture a hand paying a bill it forgot it made.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手去付一笔它忘了自己欠下的账。

examples.en: The consequence of the delay was a lost contract.
examples.cn: 这次延误的后果是丢掉了一份合同。

examples.en: He accepted the consequences of his choice.
examples.cn: 他接受了自己选择的后果。

examples.en: The decision was of great consequence to the town.
examples.cn: 这个决定对这座城镇关系重大。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consequence 记成 con（一起）加 sequ（跟随）加 ence：紧跟着行为一起到来的那件事，就是后果。

root: 源自拉丁语 consequentia（com 一起 + sequi 跟随），本义是随后而来之物，后指后果、推论与重要性。

sensesIntro.en: From what follows an act, to the weight that makes it matter, and finally to a conclusion forced by facts.
sensesIntro.cn: 从随行为而来的东西，到让它有分量的重要性，最后到事实逼出的结论。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one push, and the whole row of dominoes falls.
core.cn: 核心意象：推一下，整排骨牌倒下。

branches.en: The core sense is the result that follows an action.
branches.cn: 核心义项是随行为而来的结果。

branches.en: A result with many followers feels important.
branches.cn: 牵动许多后续的结果，就显得重要。

branches.en: In reasoning, the result is a conclusion.
branches.cn: 在推理中，这种结果就是结论。

branches.en: Serious consequences are just results heavy enough to notice.
branches.cn: 严重后果不过是重到让人不得不注意的结果。

branches.en: Both senses deal with weight, one of events and one of logic.
branches.cn: 两个义项都涉及分量，一个在事件上，一个在逻辑上。

definition_en: as a result of what has just been said

scene: 雨下了一整夜，清晨的街道空了一半。The road flooded and consequently the school closed.

senses.title: As a result
senses.definition: as a result of something just mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 由于刚提到的事而产生结果
senses.example: He missed the train and consequently arrived late.
senses.exampleCN: 他错过了火车，因此到得很晚。
senses.why: One fact ends, and the next one starts from its edge.
senses.whyCN: 一件事实结束，下一件就从它的边缘开始。

senses.title: In a logical order
senses.definition: in a way that follows logically from the facts
senses.definitionCN: 以符合事实逻辑的方式
senses.example: The figures were wrong and consequently the report was useless.
senses.exampleCN: 数字错了，所以这份报告毫无用处。
senses.why: A chain of reasoning needs a word to mark where the chain lands.
senses.whyCN: 一条推理链需要一个词，标出链条落在哪里。

senses.title: Following in time
senses.definition: happening next in time or order, an older and rarer sense
senses.definitionCN: 在时间或顺序上紧接着发生，是较古老且少用的义项
senses.example: The bell rang and consequently the hall emptied.
senses.exampleCN: 铃声响起，接着大厅就空了。
senses.why: Before it marked reasons, the word simply marked the next step.
senses.whyCN: 在标记原因之前，这个词只标记下一步。

intro.en: Consequently is consequent plus -ly, from Latin consequi, to follow after.
intro.cn: consequently 是 consequent 加 -ly，源头是拉丁语 consequi，意为随后跟上。

items.en: Sequi meant to follow, and consequi meant to follow after.
items.cn: sequi 意为跟随，consequi 意为随后跟上。

items.en: Consequens described what comes next in a chain.
items.cn: consequens 描述链条中紧接着出现的东西。

items.en: Old French consequent named a following result.
items.cn: 古法语 consequent 指随后而来的结果。

items.en: English consequent entered as an adjective of result.
items.cn: 英语 consequent 作为表示结果的形容词进入英语。

items.en: The adverb consequently was formed with -ly.
items.cn: 副词 consequently 由 -ly 构成。

items.en: It is now a common connector in formal writing.
items.cn: 如今它是正式写作中常见的连接词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the follow base, and the meaning group names other linking adverbs.
note.cn: 形近组共享跟随词基，近义组列出其他表示因果衔接的副词。

normal.en: Consequently is the adverb of consequence: it points at the result.

normal.en: It sounds heavier than so, so writers use it in reports.

normal.en: One word joins the reason to the result without a comma of doubt.

abstract.en: Picture the last domino resting on a written conclusion.
abstract.cn: 想象最后一张骨牌正好压在一句写好的结论上。

abstract.en: Picture a line drawn from one sentence to the next.
abstract.cn: 想象一条线从一句话画到下一句话。

abstract.en: Picture a bell and, one second later, an empty hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一声铃响，以及一秒后空掉的大厅。

examples.en: He missed the train and consequently arrived late.
examples.cn: 他错过了火车，因此到得很晚。

examples.en: The cost rose; consequently, fewer people came.
examples.cn: 费用上涨了，因此来的人更少了。

examples.en: She spoke quietly and consequently was barely heard.
examples.cn: 她说话很轻，结果几乎没人听见。

definition_en: the protection of nature and old things, or the careful use of resources
core_image: 护林员把幼苗周围的杂草轻轻拨开
scene: 护林员在幼苗周围插上木牌，请游人绕行。The conservation of the old forest took thirty years.
sceneCN: 这里 conservation 指「保护」（第 1 个义项：对自然或古迹的保护）；句意是这片古老森林的保护工作持续了三十年。

senses.title: Protecting nature
senses.definition: the protection of animals, plants and natural places
senses.definitionCN: 对动植物与自然环境的保护
senses.example: The conservation of the old forest took thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 这片古老森林的保护工作持续了三十年。
senses.why: A living place survives only if someone guards it on purpose.
senses.whyCN: 一片有生命的土地，只有被有意守护才能存续。

senses.title: Careful use
senses.definition: the careful use of resources so that they are not wasted
senses.definitionCN: 对资源的节约使用，避免浪费
senses.example: Water conservation begins at home.
senses.exampleCN: 节约用水从家里开始。
senses.why: What is used slowly lasts longer than what is spent fast.
senses.whyCN: 慢慢用的东西，比快速耗掉的东西用得久。

senses.title: Keeping in good condition
senses.definition: the work of keeping old buildings or objects in good condition
senses.definitionCN: 使旧建筑或旧物保持良好状态的工作
senses.example: The conservation of the wall took months.
senses.exampleCN: 这堵旧墙的修复用了好几个月。
senses.why: Old things do not stay old by accident; someone stops the decay.
senses.whyCN: 旧东西不会自己保持原样，总有人拦住了腐朽。

intro.en: Conservation comes from Latin conservatio, a keeping together, from com-, together, and servare, to keep safe.
intro.cn: conservation 来自拉丁语 conservatio，意为共同守护，由 com-（一起）与 servare（保全）构成。

items.en: Servare meant to keep safe or to watch over.
items.cn: servare 意为保全或看守。

items.en: Conservare meant to keep something whole and unharmed.
items.cn: conservare 意为使某物保持完整无损。

items.en: Conservatio named the act of guarding and keeping.
items.cn: conservatio 指守护与保存的行为。

items.en: Old French conservation carried the keeping sense.
items.cn: 古法语 conservation 带有保存的含义。

items.en: English conservation first meant preservation from harm.
items.cn: 英语 conservation 最初指免于损害的保存。

items.en: It now covers nature, energy and old buildings.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖自然、能源与古老建筑。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the sound of conservation, and the meaning group names other kinds of keeping safe.
note.cn: 形近组与 conservation 读音相近，近义组列出其他表示保护保存的词。

entries.definition: a talk between two or more people

entries.definition: an arrangement to keep a seat or room
a person who works to protect nature

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from hands clearing weeds, then move to a tap turned off and to an old wall being repaired.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从拨开杂草的手开始，再到拧紧的水龙头，最后到正在修复的旧墙。

normal.en: Con- is together and serv- is keep, so conservation is keeping something safe for everyone.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，serv- 是保存，conservation 就是大家一起把某物守住。

normal.en: A guard who walks the forest every morning is conservation in boots.
normal.cn: 每天早晨巡林的护林员，就是穿着靴子的保护工作。

normal.en: Turning off the tap is conservation with one hand.
normal.cn: 拧上水龙头，就是一只手完成的节约。

normal.en: An old wall stays old only because someone pays to repair it.
normal.cn: 旧墙能保持旧貌，只因为有人花钱修它。

normal.en: Conservation is a gift sent to people who are not born yet.
normal.cn: 保护工作是一份送给尚未出生之人的礼物。

abstract.cn: 想象一棵小树外面围着一圈矮栅栏。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closing a dripping tap.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手拧紧滴水的龙头。

abstract.en: Picture a brush cleaning dust from old stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一把刷子把旧石头上的灰尘扫掉。

examples.en: Wildlife conservation depends on local support.
examples.cn: 野生动物保护有赖于当地人的支持。

examples.en: Energy conservation saves money as well as fuel.
examples.cn: 节约能源既省钱也省燃料。

examples.en: The museum is famous for the conservation of old paper.
examples.cn: 这家博物馆以修复旧纸张闻名。

branches.en: The third sense protects what age and weather attack.

branches.en: Nature and energy both need the same habit of not wasting.

branches.en: A forest and an old wall are both kept for people not yet here.

definition_en: preferring old ways and slow change, cautious, or a deliberately low estimate
core_image: 老人试了新沙发，还是坐回那张旧木椅
scene: 搬家后老人试了试新沙发，又坐回旧木椅。He gave a conservative estimate of the cost.
sceneCN: 这里 conservative 指「偏低的；谨慎的」（第 3 个义项：估计故意低于真实数字）；句意是他对费用给出了一个偏低的估计。

senses.title: Preferring the old
senses.definition: preferring traditional ways and slow change
senses.definitionCN: 偏好传统方式与缓慢的改变
senses.example: His family is conservative about clothing.
senses.exampleCN: 他家人对穿着比较保守。
senses.why: What has lasted feels safer than what is only new.
senses.whyCN: 已经延续下来的东西，比只是新鲜的东西更让人安心。

senses.title: Cautious
senses.definition: careful and not willing to take risks
senses.definitionCN: 谨慎而不愿承担风险
senses.example: The bank took a conservative view of the market.
senses.exampleCN: 银行对市场持谨慎看法。
senses.why: A low guess is a cushion against being wrong.
senses.whyCN: 把话说低一点，是给判断失误留的垫子。

senses.title: A low estimate
senses.definition: deliberately below the real figure
senses.definitionCN: 故意低于真实数字的
senses.example: He gave a conservative estimate of the cost.
senses.exampleCN: 他对费用给出了一个偏低的估计。
senses.why: Promise little, and the final number can only surprise upward.
senses.whyCN: 把话说小，最后的数字只可能向上给人惊喜。

normal.en: The old chair is ugly and comfortable; comfort wins.

normal.en: A conservative estimate is a promise said quietly.
normal.cn: 保守的估计，是把承诺轻声说出来。

normal.en: Slow change is not no change, only change with brakes.
normal.cn: 缓慢的改变不是不改变，而是带着刹车的改变。

normal.en: When in doubt, choose the door that already opens.
normal.cn: 拿不准的时候，选那扇本来就能打开的门。

abstract.en: Picture a new room with one old chair in the middle.
abstract.cn: 想象一间新屋子，中间只摆着一把旧椅子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand placed flat on a table to steady it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手平按在桌上把桌子稳住。

abstract.en: Picture a number written small, then circled twice.

examples.en: He gave a conservative estimate of the cost.

examples.en: Her parents are conservative about marriage.
examples.cn: 她父母对婚姻的看法比较保守。

examples.en: The plan is conservative, but it will not fail.
examples.cn: 这个方案偏保守，但不会失败。

definition_en: to think about something carefully, or to regard it in a certain way

scene: 她盯着两份合同，笔尖在纸上轻轻点了两下。She needed a week to consider the offer.

senses.title: Think about
senses.definition: to think about something before deciding
senses.definitionCN: 在做出决定之前仔细思考某事
senses.example: We are considering moving to another city.
senses.exampleCN: 我们正在考虑搬到另一座城市。
senses.why: A choice is weighed in the mind before it is made by the hand.
senses.whyCN: 选择先在心里过秤，然后才由手做出。

senses.title: Regard as
senses.definition: to have an opinion about someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 对某人或某事物持有某种看法
senses.example: Many consider him the best player alive.
senses.exampleCN: 很多人认为他是当今最好的球员。
senses.why: The mind takes a position and then stands there.
senses.whyCN: 头脑选定一个位置，然后就站在那里。

senses.title: Take into account
senses.definition: to take someone's feelings or needs into account

intro.en: Consider comes from Latin considerare, to examine closely, probably from com-, together, and sidus, star, as if reading the sky.
intro.cn: consider 来自拉丁语 considerare，意为仔细审视，可能由 com-（一起）与 sidus（星）构成，仿佛在观测星空。

items.en: Sidus meant a star or a group of stars.
items.cn: sidus 意为星辰或一组星。

items.en: Considerare may have meant to observe the stars carefully.
items.cn: considerare 可能原指仔细观测星象。

items.en: From watching the sky it came to mean examining anything.
items.cn: 从仰望天空，它转而表示审视任何事物。

items.en: Old French considerer kept the sense of thinking over.
items.cn: 古法语 considerer 保留了反复思量的含义。

items.en: English consider first meant to look at something with care.
items.cn: 英语 consider 最初指带着用心去看。

items.en: It now covers thinking, judging and taking others into account.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖思考、判断与顾及他人。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on the consider family, and the meaning group names other ways of thinking something over.
note.cn: 形近组是 consider 家族，近义组列出其他表示反复思量的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from reading the stars, then move to two papers on a desk and to a friend you finally remember to ask.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 considerate 记成 consider（考虑）加 ate：做事之前先考虑到别人，就是体贴。

root: 源自拉丁语 consideratus（经过审视的），由 considerare 加 -ate 构成，本义是想得周到，后专指体贴他人。

sensesIntro.en: From careful thought, to thought turned toward other people, and finally to the small acts that prove it.
sensesIntro.cn: 从仔细思量，到把思量转向别人，最后到证明这一点的小动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a key turned slowly so no one wakes.
core.cn: 核心意象：钥匙慢慢转动，好不吵醒任何人。

branches.en: The first sense is care for another person's feelings.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是在意另一个人的感受。

branches.en: The second sense makes that care visible in words or acts.
branches.cn: 第二个义项让这份在意在言行中显露出来。

branches.en: The older sense stresses thought before action.
branches.cn: 较古老的义项强调行动之前的思量。

branches.en: Feeling for others and acting on it belong together.
branches.cn: 替别人感受与照着去做，本来就是一回事。

branches.en: A careful act is both thought through and kind.
branches.cn: 周到的举动，既经过思量，也带着善意。

intro.en: Considerate is consider plus -ate, from Latin consideratus, thought over.
intro.cn: considerate 是 consider 加 -ate，源自拉丁语 consideratus（经过思量的）。

latinIntro.en: The star base sider- also appears in sidereal, and the same root shaped desire.
latinIntro.cn: 星辰词基 sider- 也出现在 sidereal 中，同一个词根也塑造了 desire。

items.exampleCN: 体贴的主人会先问一声。
这么大声放音乐很不体谅人。
对安静的渴望越来越强。
